_readme: Prisoner Fed overrides — the FakeItem side of prisoner feeding. These define what stat effects happen to the prisoner when a feed recipe completes. Keys are FakeItem prefab names.
_types_readme: Type must be one of: FeedPrisoner (standard food), DealDamageToPrisoner (blood extraction), AffectWithToxic (irradiant food). Each type has its own set of fields.
